events.description: High volume of rapid failed login attempts (50) from IP 192.168.1.100 indicating an automated credential guessing or brute force attack.
events.action: Block source IP 192.168.1.100, enable temporary account lockouts, enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA), and audit target user accounts.

events.description: An internal IP (10.0.0.55) downloaded an unusually large volume of data (15.5 GB), indicating potential insider threat or compromised credentials.
events.action: Isolate the IP address 10.0.0.55, revoke active session tokens for the associated account, and review access logs to identify target datasets.

events.description: An internal host (172.16.0.200) performed a large-scale port scan across 1000 ports, indicating potential host compromise or lateral movement discovery.
events.action: Isolate IP 172.16.0.200 from the network, block outbound scanning traffic, and inspect the host for unauthorized scripts or malware.
